title: How To: Perform the Virginia Reel!

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher presents in character with historical costume, breaking down steps clearly with a partner and numerical counts. She uses a peer demonstrator to show movements side-by-side.

lesson_structure.note: Teacher introduces herself and the Virginia Reel in historical costume.
Explains that she will teach the partner portion of the dance and brings in a partner.
Teaches forward and backward walking steps and partner swings.
Recaps the lesson and introduces a special doll performance.
Doll performance of the Virginia Reel to Irish Washerwoman music.

cues: Take four steps back into your spot

steps_taught.name: Forward and back
steps_taught.description: Four steps forward toward partner and four steps back.

steps_taught.name: Right elbow swing
steps_taught.description: Link right elbows and swing for eight counts.

steps_taught.name: Left elbow swing
steps_taught.description: Link left elbows and swing for eight counts.

steps_taught.name: Both hands swing
steps_taught.description: Hold both hands with partner and travel clockwise for eight counts.

steps_taught.name: Back-to-back
steps_taught.description: Pass right shoulder then left shoulder passing partner back-to-back.

what_works: Clear numerical counting for each movement
Demonstration with a live partner in frame
what_hinders: Only front angle shown during instruction

quotes.text: My name is Catherine Gonzalez, and today I'll be teaching you some of the Virginia Reel.
Let's watch a special performance where there are multiple different pairs of partners.

evidence_segments.observation: Two people facing each other walking forward 4 steps and backward 4 steps
evidence_segments.cannot_infer: exact footwork details due to camera distance

evidence_segments.observation: Linking right elbows and circling around each other

extraction.distinctive_method: Using American Girl dolls in historical dress to perform the full dance routine at the end of the tutorial.
